dict.string: TaskPilot captures application, window, and display pixels on its assigned screen so it can understand and complete your task.
TaskPilot accesses Desktop files only when your task asks it to read, write, organize, or open them.
TaskPilot accesses Documents only when your task asks it to read, write, organize, or open them.
TaskPilot accesses Downloads only when your task asks it to read, write, organize, or open them.
TaskPilot accesses a network volume only when your task explicitly requires a file there.
TaskPilot accesses a removable volume only when your task explicitly requires a file there.
